# make_framework_instanced_trace { #mofography.movies.make_framework_instanced_trace }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-recommended">go-to</span> Default instanced ball-and-stick framework for interactive Three.js.

```python
movies.make_framework_instanced_trace(
    atoms,
    bonds='auto',
    style=None,
    name='Framework',
    trace_id='framework',
    atom_scale=0.65,
    bond_color=None,
    representation='ball_and_stick',
)
```

Framework as InstancedMesh spheres + cylinder mesh bonds.

Sends compact atom data for instanced spheres; browser builds sphere geometry.
representation: "ball_and_stick" (default), "stick", or "space_filling".
